feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 330 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: GitHub Actions secrets: inherit Check — Reusable Workflow Secret Exposure
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every secrets: inherit call that hands your whole secret set to an external reusable workflow, or to a job a fork can trigger. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Docker Base Image EOL Check — Is Your FROM Line Still Supported?
entry.summary: Paste your Dockerfile and find every FROM line whose base image release has passed its own end-of-life date. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Upwork vs. Fiverr Fee Calculator — What You Actually Keep
entry.summary: Free calculator comparing Upwork and Fiverr net payout for the same job price, after platform fees, withdrawal fees, and a tax reserve. Solve for the price to charge on either platform to hit a take-home goal.

entry.title: OSHA TRIR & DART Rate Calculator
entry.summary: Free OSHA TRIR and DART rate calculator: turn your OSHA 300 log's recordable case count and total hours worked into the two rates GC prequalification forms and insurance renewals ask for, and see how many injury-free hours it takes to hit a target rate. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Personal Trainer Package Pricing Calculator — Package vs. Pay-Per-Session, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent personal trainers: compares a discounted prepaid session package against pay-per-session pricing on net take-home pay per hour, after your gym or studio's percentage cut or flat facility fee — not just revenue. A flat per-session fee erodes a discounted package harder than it erodes full price, and a makeup-owed policy can turn a package's guaranteed revenue into a worse hourly rate. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Sign Language Interpreter Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free rate calculator for freelance ASL/sign language interpreters. Price a single assignment from hours, the 2-hour booking minimum, portal-to-portal travel, mileage, an after-hours/weekend/holiday differential, and a team-interpreting flag for long legal/medical/mental-health bookings — plus a late-cancellation fee calculator. Entirely client-side.

entry.title: Supabase RLS Exposure Checker — Is Your Anon Key Reading Real Rows?
entry.summary: Free, in-browser tool: paste your Supabase project URL and anon key, and it sends a real read-only request to every table it can see, naming which ones return real rows to an unauthenticated request -- the CVE-2025-48757 missing-RLS exposure class. Nothing uploaded to us.

entry.title: Voice-Over Project Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free voice-over rate calculator for freelance VO artists. Price a commercial, e-learning, IVR, or explainer script per word or per finished minute, scaled by usage/licensing term (internal, web, broadcast, buyout) — or price an audiobook per finished hour from manuscript word count. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Dimensional Weight Calculator
entry.summary: Work out the billable weight of a parcel from its box size, weight and DIM divisor — then see the box size that stops you paying for air, and whether the carton trips an additional-handling or oversize surcharge.

entry.title: 1099-K Threshold Checker — Will You Get One for 2026?
entry.summary: Check whether a marketplace, payment app, or platform is likely to send you a Form 1099-K, per platform and per tax year. Covers the federal threshold's four changes since 2022 ($20,000/200 transactions, $5,000 in 2024, back to $20,000/200 from 2025 on) plus the four states with their own stricter $600 rule. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: 1099-NEC Vendor Tracker — Free 2026 $2,000 Threshold Checker
entry.summary: Track which contractors need a 1099-NEC under the 2026 $2,000 reporting threshold (up from $600), check the corporation exemption, and see missing W-9s before the January 31 deadline. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Secret Leak Check — Masking Bypass Scanner
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find the two documented ways a secret slips past GitHub's own log masking: transforming it (base64/hex/substring) before printing, and exporting it to $GITHUB_ENV/$GITHUB_OUTPUT without ::add-mask::. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Actions Transitive Pin Check — Does Your Pinned Workflow Load Something Unpinned?
entry.summary: Paste a GitHub Actions workflow and check whether a reusable workflow or composite action it pins to a commit SHA itself loads a third-party action by a mutable tag underneath — a gap a top-level SHA pin does not close.

entry.title: Android Data Safety Checker — permissions/SDKs vs Play Console declaration
entry.summary: Free, browser-local checker: scans your AndroidManifest.xml permissions and Gradle dependencies for known analytics/ads/crash SDKs, and compares them against the Data safety categories you say you've already declared in Play Console -- so a missed declaration doesn't cost you a policy warning or listing removal. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Asbestos Abatement Bid Calculator — Containment-Class Pricing
entry.summary: Free bid calculator for licensed asbestos abatement contractors: price a removal job by OSHA/EPA containment class (I/II/III), square footage, crew and supervisor rates, air monitoring, and waste disposal — and see the gap against a flat rate per square foot.

entry.title: Biohazard Cleanup Bid Calculator — Trauma & Crime-Scene Job Pricing
entry.summary: Free calculator for biohazard and trauma-scene remediation technicians: price a job from crew labor, PPE decon cycles, and regulated-waste disposal billed per container (not per pound), then check whether a quote you're already giving clears cost.

entry.title: Branch Protection Drift Check — Does Your Repo Still Match Its Own Policy?
entry.summary: Paste a repo's actual GitHub branch protection settings (gh api branches/:branch/protection) and your declared policy to find every rule that has drifted weaker than intended — a temporarily disabled review requirement, force pushes turned back on, admin enforcement quietly off. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Call Recording Consent Check — One-Party or All-Party by State
entry.summary: Pick the caller's and recipient's US states and get an instant one-party vs. all-party call-recording consent determination, the exact statute cited, and a ready-to-read disclosure script for your call opening. Free, deterministic, runs entirely in your browser — not legal advice.

entry.title: CNC Machining Quote Calculator — Cost Per Part, Setup & Lot Size
entry.summary: Free CNC machining quote calculator for job shops: work out your real cost per part from bar or plate yield, cycle time, setup and programming, perishable tooling, first-article inspection and outside-process lot minimums — then see the break-even price, the margin at what you quoted, and the same part costed at 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250 and 500 pieces. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Deploy Concurrency Check — find the race that ships an older commit
entry.summary: Paste a GitHub Actions workflow and see every way it is allowed to apply an older revision over a newer one: no concurrency group, a group that changes every run, cancel-in-progress on a deploy, split groups on one environment, and a checkout of a moving branch. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Depreciation Recapture Calculator — Rental Property Sale Tax Estimate
entry.summary: Free calculator for landlords selling a rental or investment property: estimates depreciation recapture (Section 1250, capped at 25%), remaining capital-gains tax, and Net Investment Income Tax, then shows how much a 1031 exchange would defer. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Docker Build Secrets Check — Is a Secret Baked Into Your Image?
entry.summary: Paste your Dockerfile and find every ENV or ARG instruction whose name looks like a secret, and every COPY/ADD of a credential file like .env or id_rsa into the build. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Docker Cache Order Check — Is Your Dockerfile Busting Its Own Build Cache?
entry.summary: Paste a Dockerfile and see whether its instruction order defeats Docker's own layer cache: a dependency manifest copied and installed after the whole build context, an install command with no isolated manifest COPY at all, and an apt-get update run without install in the same layer. Free, deterministic, runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Dog Boarding & Daycare Pricing Calculator — Price a Stay, Check Occupancy
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent dog boarding and daycare facility owners: price a reservation from staff time, supplies, overhead, a long-stay discount, and a multi-dog discount, then check whether your kennel/run occupancy clears a monthly break-even.

entry.title: Equipment Auction Buyer's Premium Calculator — True Out-the-Door Cost
entry.summary: Free calculator for farm and heavy-equipment auction bidders: turns a hammer price into the true out-the-door total, including a capped buyer's premium, online-bidding premium, card surcharge, and sales tax — then works backward to a max bid for your budget. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Estate Sale Net Proceeds Calculator — Compare Company Quotes
entry.summary: Free calculator for estate sale commission quotes. Enter a company's tiered commission rates, setup fee, card-processing fee, and haul-away fee against your estimated sale total to see the real net proceeds — and compare two companies' quotes side by side. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Helm Values Schema Check — Find a values.yaml Typo Helm Won't
entry.summary: Paste a Helm chart's values.yaml and its values.schema.json and get a deterministic report of every field values.yaml sets that the schema does not declare (Helm's template engine never errors on this -- it silently returns no value), every schema-required field missing from values.yaml, and every type, enum, or min/max mismatch. Free, runs entirely in your browser, no Helm binary needed, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Import Landed Cost Calculator — Duty, Tariff & Customs Fee Breakdown
entry.summary: Free landed cost calculator for small e-commerce importers: enter your item cost, freight, duty rate, and Section 301/supplemental tariff rate to see total landed cost, cost per unit, and your real tariff burden as a percent of the invoice price — with Merchandise Processing Fee and Harbor Maintenance Fee priced from CBP's published schedule.

entry.title: Kubernetes Deprecated API Check — Find Manifests a Cluster Upgrade Will Reject
entry.summary: Paste or load Kubernetes manifest YAML and get a deterministic report of every apiVersion + kind pair a past or future Kubernetes release has removed or will remove -- extensions/v1beta1 Ingress, batch/v1beta1 CronJob, policy/v1beta1 PodSecurityPolicy, and more -- so a platform team catches the manifest before a rolling upgrade fails on it, not during it. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: No Tax on Tips & Overtime Calculator — 2026 Deduction Estimator, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the federal 'no tax on tips' and 'no tax on overtime' deductions (2025-2028): applies the $25,000 tip cap, the $12,500/$25,000 overtime cap, and the shared MAGI phase-out, and computes the overtime deduction's easy-to-miss half-time-premium-only rule. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: NY LLC Transparency Act Tracker — Deadline & Filing Organizer
entry.summary: Free browser tool for New York LLCs: check whether your LLC likely owes a Beneficial Ownership Disclosure or an Attestation of Exemption under the NY LLC Transparency Act, see your filing deadline counted down, and organize the beneficial-owner details you'll need before you email NYDOS yourself. Nothing you type is uploaded.

entry.title: OpenAPI Breaking Change Check — Did This API Version Break Existing Clients?
entry.summary: Paste two OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON documents and see exactly which changes would break an existing client — a removed endpoint, a parameter that became required, a narrowed type, a removed enum value. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Podcast Sponsorship Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free podcast sponsorship rate calculator. Enter your average downloads per episode, niche, and read type to get a price range for a pre-roll, mid-roll, and post-roll ad spot — based on commonly cited podcast-ad-market CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Propane Delivery Route Margin Calculator — Price Each Customer
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent propane (LP gas) delivery route operators: find real annual profit per customer after the retail/wholesale price spread, the minimum-delivery fee on small fills, drive time and mileage, and tank rental and hazmat compliance cost, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

entry.title: QBI Deduction Calculator — Section 199A, 2025 & 2026, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for the Section 199A qualified business income (QBI) deduction: applies the 20% deduction, the taxable-income threshold and phase-in range for 2025 and 2026 (including the OBBBA-widened 2026 range and new $400 minimum deduction), the specified-service-business (SSTB) phase-out, and the W-2 wage / UBIA limitation. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Required Checks Drift Check — Is a Branch Protection Check Stuck Forever?
entry.summary: Paste your branch protection required status checks and your GitHub Actions workflow YAML to find every required check name no job can ever report again — the reason a pull request sits at 'Expected — Waiting for status to be reported' forever. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: StockX Seller Payout Calculator — Net Profit After All Fees
entry.summary: Free calculator for StockX sneaker, streetwear, and card sellers: find real net payout and net profit after the seller fee (which drops by seller level), the Fast Shipping discount, the payment processing fee, and outbound shipping cost, then check a month of sales against a profit goal.

entry.title: Storage Auction Max Bid Calculator — What the Cost Stack Actually Supports
entry.summary: Free calculator for storage-unit auction bidders: prices the buyer's premium, realistic resale recovery, resale fees, dump and labor cost, and holding cost, then reports the bid a target margin supports, the break-even bid, and what a flat percent-of-value rule of thumb would have told you to bid instead.

entry.title: Subpath Robots Check — Is Your GitHub Pages Sitemap Ever Read?
entry.summary: A site published at a URL subpath — user.github.io/repo/, gitlab.io/project/, a CDN subdirectory — cannot govern its own robots.txt, so its sitemap is never auto-discovered and its pages are never enumerated. Paste your site URL to find out. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Tutor Package Pricing Calculator — Package vs. Pay-Per-Session, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent tutors and coaches: compares a discounted prepaid session package against pay-per-session pricing on effective hourly pay, not just revenue — the package discount can quietly cost more per hour than it saves once missed sessions are made up. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.
